about.title: About Me
about.description: I’m a music producer and sound designer with nearly a decade of experience crafting distinctive sonic worlds. What began as a simple curiosity for sound has grown into a lifelong pursuit of audio excellence. I specialize in live recordings, electronic music, ambient soundscapes, and cinematic compositions—transforming ideas into immersive stories told through sound.
